metadata.title: SGU Episode 641
metadata.quote: I'm scared to death about the denial of science. Science is real. Science is the most real thing in our world, other than nature. I'm hoping we'll all get back to a place where we can really understand that science is tested knowledge.

sections.text: You're listening to the Skeptics' Guide to the Universe, your escape to reality.
sections.title: Introduction

sections.text:
Item #1: An Atoll is a ring-shaped island that is left behind after its barrier reef has died.
Item #2: A coral’s mouth is also its anus.
Item #3: Individual coral polyps may be male, female, both, or neither and corals reproduce either sexually or asexually.
Item #4: Tropical white sand is mostly comprised of coral that was pooped out of a parrot fish.
sections.title: Science or Fiction

sections.text: 'I'm scared to death about the denial of science. Science is real. Science is the most real thing in our world, other than nature. I'm hoping we'll all get back to a place where we can really understand that science is tested knowledge.' -Harrison Ford
